data.name: Downhill Bike Adventure
data.headline: All Ages  • Appx. 3 hours tour
data.description:
#Take a downhill ride in an Oahu, Hawaii rainforest on this trip!

Experience another specialty of Bike Hawaii Tours on our most sought after downhill bike ride. This easy 5-mile tropical bike ride coasts downhill on a paved road nestled in Oahu’s lush Puu Ohia rainforest. This unique experience combines Hawaii’s tropical rainforest, magnificent panoramic views of scenic Oahu, the fragrance of tropical fruits and flowers with Hawaiian culture, history, native species of bird and animals and its unique geological features. A great Hawaii bike tour for the family! Not recommended for children under 5 years of age.

meeting_point.address: We will pick you up in Waikiki in our air-conditioned shuttle

data.what_is_included: - This Hawaii downhill biking adventure is available on its own, or can be combined with additional adventures on the same day. To customize your experience, the following adventure combinations are available.
data.cancellation_notes: When booking this activity through a 3rd party, their cancellation policy applies. When booking direct, our cancellation policy is 24 hours before the tour. 50% within 24 hours and full charge for No Show.
data.booking_notes:
#WHAT'S INCLUDED
Round Trip van transportation from Waikiki, bike and helmet, water and snacks.. Waist pack, rain jacket and mosquito repellent also provided.
 
**Note:** Gratuities are not included. Suggested gratuity: 10% of tour price.

#WHAT TO BRING
Guests are urged to bring your own water and snacks! Wear closed toe shoes and dress comfortable and bring a camera.

##NOTE: 
Riders must be minimum 4'0" tall to ride the bike. Tag-a-long trailer riders must be a minimum 3'5" and able to demonstrate ability.
